text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City took a magnificent 1st place in 
the Japan Cup. She was enveloped in 
cheers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing the moved spectators call out how 
"beautiful" she was, she answered with a 
smile. The stands erupted in even greater 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Overcome with emotion, the Trainer offered 
the word "beautiful." She accepted it with 
a smile. —And then, Gold City speaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter how others see me. I'll 
just keep running beautifully. Because the 
me who runs is who "I" truly am—
